verdict.rationale: A payments platform with a merchant Customer Area could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside the product. The MCP server lets developers use natural language through their own external LLM client, which is a different capability (MCP server) and a developer building block, not an in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
